ITEM 1 | Bright green broccoli florets, medium-sized clusters with dense, slightly bumpy tops and firm stems, spread across the lower left and right sides of the bowl, covering roughly 25% of the bowl; matte surface with moist sheen, sitting under and between the other items | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-green lettuce or cabbage-like leaves, crinkled and limp with thin translucent edges, forming a base layer across the bowl and visible around the edges, covering roughly 30% of the bowl; slightly glossy with a little moisture, sitting under the other ingredients | 90
ITEM 3 | Cubed light beige-white pieces, about 1.5 to 2 cm per side, with firm cut edges and slightly golden-browned spots on some faces, scattered densely across the center and right side, covering roughly 35% of the bowl; matte, moist-looking surface, holding their cube shape and piled up to about 2 cm high in places | 150
ITEM 4 | Small golden-brown seared bits and crisp-edged pieces mixed among the cubes and greens near the center, about 0.5 to 1 cm each, covering under 5% of the bowl; dry, slightly darker surface with visible browning, sitting among the cubes and leaves | 10
